A layout table renders its rows as list items, and those markers honour the bullets option like any other list

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val options = mapper.readValue("{\"bullets\":\"*+-\"}", ConversionOptions::class.java)
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<table><tr><td>alpha</td><td>beta</td></tr><tr><td>a</td><td>b</td><td>c</td></tr></table>", options)
    println(result.content)
}
```
